### Q-WID-10 · An old question

### Q-WID-2 · Widgets come in `pairs` of a|b

Status: **Decided by the owner on 2026-11-20** — option (b), as recommended.

| Option | What it means | For | Against |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) One widget | — | Cheap | Lonely |
| (b) Two widgets, `a\|b` (chosen) | — | Company | Twice the cost |

**Choice:** (b). **Rationale:** widgets like company.
